title: Environmental Microbiology Visualization Atlas
scope: Curated visualization formats and applied recipes; not an exhaustive systematic literature review or a claim that every format appeared in the cited journals.

evidence_definitions.direct: The cited figure or method explicitly uses the encoding. Proposed application and design advice may extend the example.
evidence_definitions.adaptation: The source motivates the application or related visual structure; this exact recipe is a proposed adaptation.
evidence_definitions.proposal: Additional useful format proposed for the project; no inspected journal example is claimed.

entries.name: Sampling-location map
entries.question: Where were communities sampled?
entries.minimum_data: Coordinates, site IDs, habitat and sampling effort
entries.design_tip: Quiet basemap, meaningful locator inset, stable habitat colours
entries.interpretation_limit: Projection and symbol area matter; sampling density is not biodiversity

entries.name: Environmental raster with sampling overlay
entries.question: Which gradients does the design cover?
entries.minimum_data: Georeferenced environmental raster and sample coordinates
entries.design_tip: Light continuous background with legible site markers
entries.interpretation_limit: Match raster date, spatial resolution and coordinate system to sampling

entries.name: Predicted-distribution map with uncertainty companion
entries.question: Where is a taxon, function or diversity metric predicted?
entries.minimum_data: Fitted spatial predictions, uncertainty and training locations
entries.design_tip: Aligned prediction and uncertainty maps with shared geography
entries.interpretation_limit: Extrapolation and spatial validation must be visible; predictions are not measurements

entries.name: Faceted geographic maps
entries.question: How do seasons, depths or taxa differ geographically?
entries.minimum_data: Comparable mapped values for several groups
entries.design_tip: Reuse extent, projection and scale across small multiples
entries.interpretation_limit: Separate colour limits can manufacture apparent differences

entries.name: Depth or transect profile
entries.question: How does abundance change through sediment, soil or water?
entries.minimum_data: Depth or distance, observations, units and replicate IDs
entries.design_tip: Put depth downward; align microbial and chemical profiles
entries.interpretation_limit: Do not connect unrelated sites as a continuous trajectory

entries.name: Distance–depth section or contour map
entries.question: Where are subsurface hotspots along a transect?
entries.minimum_data: Spatially resolved depth profiles and sampling support
entries.design_tip: Overlay measured positions on the section
entries.interpretation_limit: Smooth interpolation can imply unsupported structures between sparse samples

entries.name: Experimental-design schematic
entries.question: How are sites, treatments and repeated samples related?
entries.minimum_data: Actual allocation, hierarchy and sampling schedule
entries.design_tip: Show nesting and replication using concise labels
entries.interpretation_limit: Diagram geometry does not encode sample quantity unless explicitly defined

entries.name: Analysis-dependency workflow
entries.question: Which measurements support each result?
entries.minimum_data: Real input, transformation and output dependencies
entries.design_tip: Use compact branching paths and consistent data glyphs
entries.interpretation_limit: Arrows must mean dependencies; distinguish experimental and computational steps

entries.name: Boxplot with observations
entries.question: How does alpha diversity vary among habitats?
entries.minimum_data: Per-sample metric, group and biological replicate
entries.design_tip: Overlay restrained raw points and show group sample sizes
entries.interpretation_limit: Define whiskers; many technical replicates do not increase biological n

entries.name: Violin or bean plot
entries.question: Are distributions skewed or multimodal?
entries.minimum_data: Enough independent observations per group
entries.design_tip: Align density shapes and add median and observations
entries.interpretation_limit: Kernel bandwidth can invent apparent modes in small samples

entries.name: Raincloud plot
entries.question: How do distribution, observations and central tendency agree?
entries.minimum_data: Per-unit values and group IDs
entries.design_tip: Combine half-density, points and a compact interval summary
entries.interpretation_limit: Density is unreliable with very small n; specify the interval meaning

entries.name: Ridgeline distributions
entries.question: How do distributions shift across many ordered groups?
entries.minimum_data: Repeated comparable measurements and an ordered grouping
entries.design_tip: Use a common axis and modest overlap
entries.interpretation_limit: Per-ridge normalization hides differences in sample quantity

entries.name: Empirical cumulative distribution function
entries.question: What fraction of samples lies below a threshold?
entries.minimum_data: Individual values, including eligible zeros
entries.design_tip: Label selected thresholds and use direct group labels
entries.interpretation_limit: Distinguish censoring and missing data from measured zeros

entries.name: Histogram or density overlay
entries.question: What is the size or spread of a measurement?
entries.minimum_data: Contig lengths, cell sizes or other per-unit values
entries.design_tip: Use common bins and a clear log scale when needed
entries.interpretation_limit: Conclusions should not depend on a convenient bin width

entries.name: Rank-abundance curve
entries.question: Is a community dominated by a few populations?
entries.minimum_data: Comparable abundance estimates and taxon ranks
entries.design_tip: Emphasize dominance and tail shape with consistent axes
entries.interpretation_limit: Relative and absolute abundance answer different questions

entries.name: Rarefaction or accumulation curve
entries.question: How much additional diversity does sampling reveal?
entries.minimum_data: Count data or discovery histories, effort and resampling results
entries.design_tip: Show observed effort, uncertainty and any extrapolation boundary
entries.interpretation_limit: Distinguish sample-based from read-based effort; do not equate saturation with complete sampling

entries.name: Hill-diversity profile
entries.question: Do group rankings depend on sensitivity to rare taxa?
entries.minimum_data: Diversity estimates across orders q with uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Plot effective diversity on shared axes across q
entries.interpretation_limit: Richness, Shannon-derived and Simpson-derived measures need compatible estimation

entries.name: Ordered stacked abundance bars
entries.question: Which dominant taxa or functions characterize samples?
entries.minimum_data: Taxon-by-sample abundance with a defined denominator
entries.design_tip: Keep category order stable and aggregate the long tail transparently
entries.interpretation_limit: Relative increases need not mean absolute growth; middle segments are hard to compare

entries.name: Annotated abundance heatmap
entries.question: Which taxa covary across environmental groups?
entries.minimum_data: Transformed feature matrix, sample metadata and declared ordering
entries.design_tip: Add compact metadata tracks and a legible continuous scale
entries.interpretation_limit: Row z-scores erase between-taxon abundance differences; zeros need explicit handling

entries.name: Abundance–prevalence dot matrix
entries.question: Which taxa are abundant and consistently detected?
entries.minimum_data: Group-level abundance and detection fraction from sample-level data
entries.design_tip: Use dot area for prevalence and colour for abundance
entries.interpretation_limit: Area must encode magnitude; disclose aggregation and detection thresholds

entries.name: Ordered presence–absence matrix
entries.question: Are communities nested or characterized by turnover?
entries.minimum_data: Binary occurrence matrix and detection definition
entries.design_tip: Order rows and columns by a justified ecological criterion
entries.interpretation_limit: Non-detection is not proof of absence; ordering affects apparent nestedness

entries.name: Ternary composition plot
entries.question: How do samples divide among three components?
entries.minimum_data: Three mutually exclusive components summing to a common whole
entries.design_tip: Use readable corner labels and restrained reference lines
entries.interpretation_limit: Other components cannot disappear silently; closure induces dependence

entries.name: Taxonomic treemap
entries.question: How is abundance distributed within a hierarchy?
entries.minimum_data: Consistent taxonomy and nested totals
entries.design_tip: Limit hierarchy depth and label major regions
entries.interpretation_limit: Area is weak for precise comparisons; parent and child totals must reconcile

entries.name: Taxonomic sunburst or icicle plot
entries.question: How do broad groups subdivide into finer taxa?
entries.minimum_data: A genuine taxonomy with counts at leaves
entries.design_tip: Prefer an interactive drill-down with an accessible tabular counterpart
entries.interpretation_limit: Equal-looking sectors can be hard to compare; distinguish taxonomy from phylogeny

entries.name: UpSet intersection plot
entries.question: Which genes or taxa are shared among many groups?
entries.minimum_data: Explicit sets with unique entity IDs
entries.design_tip: Align the membership matrix with intersection and set sizes
entries.interpretation_limit: Specify exclusive versus inclusive intersections and account for filtered entities

entries.name: Venn or Euler diagram
entries.question: Which members are shared among two or three small sets?
entries.minimum_data: Set memberships and intersection counts
entries.design_tip: Use a few labelled sets; prioritize numbers over decorative areas
entries.interpretation_limit: More than a few sets becomes unreadable; area proportionality is not automatic

references.locator: Fig. 6a (larger-set Venn; simpler use recommended here)

entries.name: Membership alluvial diagram
entries.question: How do classifications or memberships connect across levels?
entries.minimum_data: Entity-level links with counts or weights
entries.design_tip: Minimize crossings and define ribbon width
entries.interpretation_limit: This represents membership, not necessarily temporal movement or conserved material

entries.name: PCoA or NMDS sample ordination
entries.question: Which communities are compositionally similar?
entries.minimum_data: A justified distance matrix and ordination coordinates
entries.design_tip: Use equal geometric scaling and stable habitat symbols
entries.interpretation_limit: Label PCoA variance or NMDS stress appropriately; group separation alone is not a test

entries.name: PCA biplot
entries.question: Which measured variables explain sample variation?
entries.minimum_data: Appropriately transformed continuous matrix and loadings
entries.design_tip: Show only interpretable loading vectors with the scaling stated
entries.interpretation_limit: PCA on untransformed relative abundance can be misleading

entries.name: Constrained ordination or environmental-vector overlay
entries.question: How does community structure relate to measured gradients?
entries.minimum_data: RDA/CCA/dbRDA scores or fitted vectors on an ordination
entries.design_tip: Reduce overlapping arrows and show the chosen scaling
entries.interpretation_limit: A constrained analysis differs from post-hoc vector fitting; neither establishes causation

references.locator: Extended Data Fig. 5i–l verifies the vector-overlay variant

entries.name: Chronological ordination trajectory
entries.question: How does a community move after a disturbance?
entries.minimum_data: One shared ordination, timestamps and replicate IDs
entries.design_tip: Connect observations within each real time series only
entries.interpretation_limit: Axis drift across separately fitted ordinations invalidates apparent trajectories

entries.name: Procrustes comparison
entries.question: Do two community representations preserve similar structure?
entries.minimum_data: Matched sample IDs and two coordinate configurations
entries.design_tip: Connect paired points and summarize residual mismatch
entries.interpretation_limit: Specify alignment and permutation design; low residuals do not imply identical biology

entries.name: Distance-decay display
entries.question: Does community dissimilarity rise with geographic or environmental distance?
entries.minimum_data: Pairwise distances and identities of the underlying samples
entries.design_tip: Show data density or distance-bin distributions with a justified fit
entries.interpretation_limit: Pairwise comparisons share samples and are not independent replicates

entries.name: Joint scatterplot with marginal distributions
entries.question: How do macrodiversity and microdiversity vary together?
entries.minimum_data: Two per-sample metrics and group labels
entries.design_tip: Align marginal distributions with the central scatter axes
entries.interpretation_limit: Aggregated group relationships can differ from sample-level relationships

entries.name: Forest or coefficient interval plot
entries.question: How large and uncertain are treatment effects?
entries.minimum_data: Effect estimates, intervals, units and reference groups
entries.design_tip: Align estimates to a meaningful null line and order scientifically
entries.interpretation_limit: State the model and interval type; effect estimates must respect the study design

entries.name: Volcano plot
entries.question: Which features show substantial and supported changes?
entries.minimum_data: Valid effect sizes and adjusted significance values
entries.design_tip: Label a small, pre-specified subset and disclose thresholds
entries.interpretation_limit: A visually extreme point may have unstable low counts; use composition-aware inference where needed

entries.name: MA or mean–difference plot
entries.question: Does apparent change depend on feature abundance?
entries.minimum_data: Mean abundance and estimated between-group change
entries.design_tip: Use density shading for crowds and highlight robust features
entries.interpretation_limit: State the transformation; pseudocounts can dominate rare-feature effects

entries.name: Paired slope or dumbbell plot
entries.question: Do the same samples or sites change under treatment?
entries.minimum_data: Paired observations and stable pair IDs
entries.design_tip: Keep pair connections light and emphasize a summary only if useful
entries.interpretation_limit: Pairing cannot be inferred from two unrelated groups

entries.name: Modelled response curve with uncertainty
entries.question: Is a response linear, saturating or unimodal?
entries.minimum_data: Raw observations, model predictions and uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Keep observations visible and show the sampled predictor range
entries.interpretation_limit: Smooth curves are model outputs; avoid unsupported extrapolation

entries.name: Interaction or reaction-norm plot
entries.question: Does a treatment effect depend on an environmental context?
entries.minimum_data: Factorial or longitudinal estimates with appropriate uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Use shared axes and a concise line-style key
entries.interpretation_limit: Interactions need estimable contrasts and sufficient replication

entries.name: Correlation heatmap or correlogram
entries.question: Which environmental measurements covary?
entries.minimum_data: Pairwise association estimates and sample availability
entries.design_tip: Use a diverging scale centered on zero and meaningful ordering
entries.interpretation_limit: Correlation is not causation; composition, multiple testing and repeated observations matter

entries.name: Environmental association matrix with linked edges
entries.question: Which community summaries associate with environmental variables?
entries.minimum_data: Environmental correlations and justified community-distance association estimates
entries.design_tip: Combine a compact matrix with a small number of clearly keyed links
entries.interpretation_limit: Partial Mantel-style displays are not universal causal or confounder-control solutions

entries.name: Aligned abundance and environment time series
entries.question: Do community changes coincide with environmental events?
entries.minimum_data: Time-stamped measurements with replicate identities
entries.design_tip: Align time axes; show raw observations alongside any smoothing
entries.interpretation_limit: Do not interpolate long gaps or confuse temporal association with a mechanism

entries.name: Time-ordered taxon heatmap
entries.question: Which taxa bloom or disappear together?
entries.minimum_data: Taxon-by-time matrix and sampling intervals
entries.design_tip: Preserve chronology and add event or chemistry tracks
entries.interpretation_limit: Row scaling and uneven intervals can exaggerate apparent synchrony

entries.name: Stacked-area succession plot
entries.question: How does overall composition change over time?
entries.minimum_data: Comparable relative or absolute abundances through time
entries.design_tip: Use stable taxon order and directly label dominant components
entries.interpretation_limit: Interpolation implies continuity; changing relative areas need not reflect biomass changes

entries.name: Time–depth heatmap or Hovmöller diagram
entries.question: When do microbial or chemical layers shift?
entries.minimum_data: Repeated depth profiles with timestamps
entries.design_tip: Overlay measured sampling support and align related variables
entries.interpretation_limit: Sparse sampling does not support smooth migrating fronts without a model

entries.name: Lagged association correlogram
entries.question: Does one process tend to precede another?
entries.minimum_data: Sufficiently long aligned time series and lag estimates
entries.design_tip: Plot signed lag with uncertainty or null-reference bands
entries.interpretation_limit: Autocorrelation, uneven sampling and shared drivers can generate false lead–lag patterns

entries.name: Wavelet or time–frequency spectrum
entries.question: Does periodicity vary during a bloom or season?
entries.minimum_data: A sufficiently resolved time series and a wavelet analysis
entries.design_tip: Label periods and the cone of influence clearly
entries.interpretation_limit: Edge effects and temporal resolution constrain interpretable cycles

entries.name: Disturbance–recovery trajectory
entries.question: How resistant and resilient are communities?
entries.minimum_data: Before/during/after measurements, controls and a defined reference state
entries.design_tip: Align the perturbation window and show replicate paths
entries.interpretation_limit: Return in one metric does not prove complete ecological recovery

entries.name: Rectangular annotated phylogram
entries.question: Which evolutionary relationships support a focal claim?
entries.minimum_data: Inferred tree, branch lengths, support and tip metadata
entries.design_tip: Use aligned tip labels and concise trait strips
entries.interpretation_limit: A dendrogram is not a phylogeny; state rooting and support conventions

references.locator: Fig. 1 overview tree; proposed rectangular detail view

entries.name: Circular phylogeny with metadata rings
entries.question: How do habitat, novelty and traits vary across a large tree?
entries.minimum_data: Tree plus metadata joined by stable tip IDs
entries.design_tip: Keep rings aligned and label only readable clade levels
entries.interpretation_limit: Circular layout must preserve tree meaning; too many rings obscure both data and labels

entries.name: Phylogeny linked to a heatmap
entries.question: Which functional repertoires follow evolutionary structure?
entries.minimum_data: Tree and feature matrix with matched identifiers
entries.design_tip: Reuse the exact tip order and align matrix rows to tips
entries.interpretation_limit: Different missing-data mechanisms must not be rendered as absence

entries.name: Collapsed-clade phylogenetic overview
entries.question: Which major lineages expand an environmental catalogue?
entries.minimum_data: Tree and explicit clade-collapse rules
entries.design_tip: Pair overview wedges with a separate readable focal subtree
entries.interpretation_limit: Wedge area is not species richness unless encoded and declared

entries.name: Tanglegram or cophylogeny display
entries.question: Are host and symbiont evolutionary patterns concordant?
entries.minimum_data: Two independently inferred trees and supported links
entries.design_tip: Optimize leaf order without changing topology
entries.interpretation_limit: Crossings alone do not demonstrate host switching or coevolution

entries.name: Ancestral-state or evolutionary-placement tree
entries.question: Where are traits or environmental sequences inferred to occur?
entries.minimum_data: Tree with state probabilities or placement likelihoods
entries.design_tip: Encode uncertainty and retain ambiguous placements
entries.interpretation_limit: Reconstructed states and placements are model-dependent, not directly observed ancestors

entries.name: Linear genome annotation tracks
entries.question: What is the organization of a focal genome region?
entries.minimum_data: Coordinates, gene annotations, strand and coverage
entries.design_tip: Share genomic coordinates across gene, coverage and GC tracks
entries.interpretation_limit: Assemblies and annotations have uncertainty; coordinate conventions must match

entries.name: Synteny ribbon plot
entries.question: Which gene blocks are conserved or rearranged?
entries.minimum_data: Homologous regions, alignments and genome coordinates
entries.design_tip: Use consistent gene colours and restrained identity ribbons
entries.interpretation_limit: Reverse complements and alignment filtering change apparent rearrangements

entries.name: Circular genome or Circos track plot
entries.question: How do features and long-range links span a genome?
entries.minimum_data: Genomic coordinates, quantitative tracks and supported links
entries.design_tip: Reserve the centre for a small number of interpretable links
entries.interpretation_limit: Circular artwork is not evidence that an assembled contig is circular

entries.name: Pangenome presence–absence matrix
entries.question: Which gene families are core or accessory across genomes?
entries.minimum_data: Gene-family membership and genome-quality metadata
entries.design_tip: Link annotation tracks to a stable genome order
entries.interpretation_limit: Missing genes in incomplete MAGs are not reliable biological absences

entries.name: Genome similarity matrix
entries.question: Which genomes form closely related groups?
entries.minimum_data: ANI or other similarity plus alignment coverage
entries.design_tip: Show a common ordering and make uncomputed cells distinct
entries.interpretation_limit: High identity over a short aligned fraction does not establish whole-genome similarity

entries.name: Biosynthetic gene-cluster architecture
entries.question: How do domains and gene modules form a biosynthetic system?
entries.minimum_data: BGC boundaries, gene/domain calls and coordinates
entries.design_tip: Group repeated modules and label mechanistically important domains
entries.interpretation_limit: Predicted biosynthetic potential does not establish product chemistry or expression

entries.name: Read-recruitment or coverage–identity plot
entries.question: Do reads support discrete populations or contaminants?
entries.minimum_data: Read positions, mapping identity and alignment filters
entries.design_tip: Align identity/coverage patterns to a reference genome
entries.interpretation_limit: Multi-mapping and coverage thresholds affect apparent population boundaries

entries.name: Genome-position allele-frequency landscape
entries.question: Where does microdiversity concentrate?
entries.minimum_data: Variant coordinates, allele frequencies and per-site coverage
entries.design_tip: Add gene context and flag low-confidence regions
entries.interpretation_limit: Mapping bias, recombination and coverage can mimic biological hotspots

entries.name: Sequence logo or motif alignment
entries.question: Which residues or bases are conserved?
entries.minimum_data: Aligned sequences, weights and a defined background model
entries.design_tip: Focus on a biologically justified region and show informative positions
entries.interpretation_limit: Conservation is not functional validation; uneven sampling affects letter heights

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: Virus–host bipartite network
entries.question: Which hosts are supported for which viral populations?
entries.minimum_data: Viral IDs, host IDs, evidence types and confidence
entries.design_tip: Keep host and virus node sets distinct and key edge evidence
entries.interpretation_limit: Prediction and demonstrated infection must remain distinguishable

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: CRISPR spacer–protospacer match matrix
entries.question: Which spacer evidence supports candidate hosts?
entries.minimum_data: Spacer matches, identity/coverage thresholds and host provenance
entries.design_tip: Sort by host taxonomy and show evidence strength
entries.interpretation_limit: A spacer match may record historical contact and does not establish current infection

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: Viral gene-sharing network
entries.question: How are unclassified viruses related by gene content?
entries.minimum_data: Viral proteins, homologous clusters and defined similarity edges
entries.design_tip: Emphasize stable modules and label reference anchors
entries.interpretation_limit: Network clusters are not automatically phylogenetic clades or formal taxa

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: AMG evidence composite
entries.question: Does a putative viral metabolic gene have coherent evolutionary and genomic support?
entries.minimum_data: Gene tree, contig context, annotation support and abundance
entries.design_tip: Link the focal gene across a tree, genomic track and habitat panel
entries.interpretation_limit: Cellular contamination and uncertain annotation must be assessed before calling an AMG

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: Prophage integration or mobile-element context plot
entries.question: Where does a mobile element sit relative to host genes?
entries.minimum_data: Host contig, element boundaries and supporting read/alignment evidence
entries.design_tip: Align boundary evidence, flanking genes and local coverage
entries.interpretation_limit: Uncertain boundaries and chimeric assemblies can create false integrations

entries.family: Viromes, hosts and mobile genetic elements
entries.name: Host-link evidence composition plot
entries.question: Which host assignments rely on which evidence types?
entries.minimum_data: Assignment counts with a unique denominator and evidence categories
entries.design_tip: Include unassigned genomes and label evidence methods
entries.interpretation_limit: Nonexclusive evidence categories cannot be stacked as disjoint totals without a rule

entries.name: Module-focused node–link network
entries.question: Which association modules organize an ecological dataset?
entries.minimum_data: Nodes, filtered edges, signs, weights and inference method
entries.design_tip: Use a fixed layout seed and clear module labels
entries.interpretation_limit: Co-occurrence does not prove interaction; compositional and environmental confounding matter

entries.name: Adjacency matrix
entries.question: Where are dense, signed or cross-module associations?
entries.minimum_data: A defined adjacency matrix and node metadata
entries.design_tip: Order by modules and use a centered signed scale
entries.interpretation_limit: Make filtered, untested and zero-valued edges distinguishable

entries.name: Chord diagram
entries.question: Which higher-level groups have strong many-to-many links?
entries.minimum_data: Aggregated links with a declared weight and denominator
entries.design_tip: Limit sectors and separate positive from negative associations
entries.interpretation_limit: Ribbons encode association totals, not material exchange; aggregation can conceal heterogeneity

entries.name: Ego-network or focal subnetwork
entries.question: What connects a focal taxon, metabolite or process?
entries.minimum_data: Full network and explicit focal-node selection rule
entries.design_tip: Keep neighbours readable and summarize the surrounding context
entries.interpretation_limit: A visually central node is not necessarily an ecological keystone

entries.name: Comparable network small multiples
entries.question: How do relational patterns differ across biomes or treatments?
entries.minimum_data: Comparable network estimates and stable node identities
entries.design_tip: Reuse node positions, filters and edge scaling
entries.interpretation_limit: Unequal sample sizes or thresholds can manufacture differences in topology

entries.name: Network statistic versus null-model display
entries.question: Are connectivity or modularity patterns unusual under a stated null?
entries.minimum_data: Observed statistics, null ensembles and uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Show reference distributions alongside observed values
entries.interpretation_limit: A result depends on the null model; graph fit does not validate biological mechanisms

entries.name: Pathway completeness heatmap
entries.question: Which genomes encode which metabolic capacities?
entries.minimum_data: Genome-by-pathway calls, evidence and completeness metadata
entries.design_tip: Group pathways by process and align genome-quality tracks
entries.interpretation_limit: MAG incompleteness and alternative pathway routes complicate absence calls

entries.name: Functional enrichment dot plot
entries.question: Which processes are overrepresented among selected features?
entries.minimum_data: Enrichment statistics, term sizes, background universe and adjusted values
entries.design_tip: Use dot area for a meaningful quantity and colour for one statistic
entries.interpretation_limit: The tested background and overlapping terms affect interpretation

entries.name: Enrichment similarity network
entries.question: Which enriched pathways share genes?
entries.minimum_data: Gene-set membership and a specified overlap measure
entries.design_tip: Collapse redundant terms and label coherent groups
entries.interpretation_limit: Links represent shared membership, not biochemical reactions

entries.name: Annotated biogeochemical-cycle map
entries.question: Which organisms may perform steps in carbon, nitrogen or sulfur cycling?
entries.minimum_data: Supported reactions with genes, taxa and abundance annotations
entries.design_tip: Use recognizable chemical species and a compact directional layout
entries.interpretation_limit: Genome-derived potential is not measured activity or flux

entries.name: Measured-flux Sankey diagram
entries.question: How does quantified material move between compartments?
entries.minimum_data: Comparable, mass-balanced flux estimates and units
entries.design_tip: Make arrow width proportional to flux and show residual pools
entries.interpretation_limit: Gene counts and relative abundance cannot be substituted for material flux

entries.name: Reaction-level pathway map
entries.question: Which enzymes or metabolites differ along a pathway?
entries.minimum_data: Reaction graph with measurements mapped to stable identifiers
entries.design_tip: Use a restrained diverging scale and separate unmeasured reactions
entries.interpretation_limit: Distinguish annotation, expression, metabolite concentration and estimated flux

references.locator: Fig. 4 and Extended Data pathway figures

entries.name: Isotope or stoichiometric relationship plot
entries.question: Do isotope signatures or elemental ratios distinguish processes?
entries.minimum_data: Measured isotope/element values, units, uncertainty and reference endmembers
entries.design_tip: Use clear bivariate axes or an appropriately defined ternary system
entries.interpretation_limit: Mixing lines and source fractions require justified endmembers and models

entries.name: Metabolic-handoff schematic
entries.question: Which organisms could exchange sequential metabolic products?
entries.minimum_data: Evidence-linked reaction capabilities and proposed exchange paths
entries.design_tip: Distinguish measured exchange from hypothesized links graphically
entries.interpretation_limit: Shared capabilities alone do not establish metabolite transfer

entries.name: Aligned multi-omics heatmaps
entries.question: Do genes, transcripts, proteins and metabolites vary together?
entries.minimum_data: Matched sample IDs and separately normalized omics matrices
entries.design_tip: Share sample order while retaining an appropriate scale for each layer
entries.interpretation_limit: Missing modalities and incompatible normalization can dominate apparent patterns

entries.name: Cross-omics association matrix
entries.question: Which features covary across measurement layers?
entries.minimum_data: Matched samples and appropriately estimated associations
entries.design_tip: Use clear layer boundaries and controlled feature selection
entries.interpretation_limit: Shared batch effects and compositional closure can generate spurious links

entries.name: Latent-factor scores and loadings
entries.question: Which shared axes explain variation across omics?
entries.minimum_data: Fitted factor scores, feature weights and variance estimates
entries.design_tip: Pair sample scores with compact, signed feature loadings
entries.interpretation_limit: Factors depend on modelling assumptions and may encode technical variation

entries.name: Taxon–function contribution matrix
entries.question: Which taxa contribute to which community functions?
entries.minimum_data: Gene-to-taxon assignments and justified per-sample contributions
entries.design_tip: Align taxa and pathways and use a common quantitative scale
entries.interpretation_limit: Multi-mapping and unassigned functions require explicit treatment

entries.name: Taxon–gene–metabolite multipartite graph
entries.question: Which cross-layer links support a mechanistic hypothesis?
entries.minimum_data: Stable cross-layer IDs and measured or evidence-qualified links
entries.design_tip: Use separate node columns and distinct evidence styles
entries.interpretation_limit: Mixed edge types cannot all be interpreted as direct biological causation

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Multiplex fluorescence image composite
entries.question: Which organisms occupy the same microhabitat?
entries.minimum_data: Registered measured channels, taxon identities and scale calibration
entries.design_tip: Use readable channel colours, scale bars and enlarged detail regions
entries.interpretation_limit: State processing; fluorescence intensity is not automatically cell abundance

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Segmented cell-identity map
entries.question: How are individual taxa spatially arranged?
entries.minimum_data: Image masks, cell labels, segmentation QC and coordinates
entries.design_tip: Preserve cell geometry and provide a raw-image comparison
entries.interpretation_limit: Segmentation and classification uncertainty affect every downstream spatial statistic

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Spatial pair-correlation or distance-to-boundary plot
entries.question: Are cells clustered, excluded or boundary-associated?
entries.minimum_data: Cell positions, tissue/particle boundary and an appropriate spatial null
entries.design_tip: Show distance units and uncertainty alongside images
entries.interpretation_limit: Correct for edge effects; fields of view are nested within biological samples

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Spatial-neighbourhood interaction matrix
entries.question: Which taxa are adjacent more often than expected?
entries.minimum_data: Cell identities, adjacency definition and spatial randomization results
entries.design_tip: Order taxa coherently and show signed enrichment
entries.interpretation_limit: Physical proximity does not establish exchange or direct interaction

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Confocal z-section or three-dimensional volume
entries.question: What is the actual architecture of a biofilm or aggregate?
entries.minimum_data: Calibrated image stack, voxel dimensions and segmentation
entries.design_tip: Pair a volume view with orthogonal sections and scale bars
entries.interpretation_limit: Occlusion and anisotropic resolution can hide structures; 3D is justified only by spatial data

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Raman or NanoSIMS activity map
entries.question: Which cells or microregions incorporate labelled substrates?
entries.minimum_data: Measured spectra or ion maps, controls and spatial registration
entries.design_tip: Align activity signal with cell boundaries or taxon labels
entries.interpretation_limit: Isotope enrichment and spectral peaks need calibrated biological interpretation

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Single-cell embedding with expression overlays
entries.question: Which measured cell states differ in expression?
entries.minimum_data: Valid cell-by-gene matrix, QC and embedding settings
entries.design_tip: Show selected marker overlays and stable cell annotations
entries.interpretation_limit: Embedding distances, cluster sizes and trajectories are not direct biological quantities

references.locator: Fig. 1 t-SNE (UMAP is an additional option)

entries.family: Microscopy, spatial ecology and single cells
entries.name: Kymograph or position–time image
entries.question: How do cells or activity fronts move over time?
entries.minimum_data: Registered time-lapse images and a defined spatial sampling path
entries.design_tip: Use consistent temporal sampling and a clear spatial axis
entries.interpretation_limit: Motion, drift and changing focus can mimic biological dynamics

entries.name: Observed-versus-predicted scatterplot
entries.question: Does a model predict environmental measurements accurately?
entries.minimum_data: Held-out predictions, observations and split labels
entries.design_tip: Include the identity line and meaningful error summaries
entries.interpretation_limit: Training fit is not generalization; spatial or site leakage can inflate performance

entries.name: ROC and precision–recall curves
entries.question: How well does a classifier separate classes?
entries.minimum_data: Held-out scores, labels and class prevalence
entries.design_tip: Pair curves with prevalence-aware baselines and uncertainty
entries.interpretation_limit: ROC can look strong for rare classes while precision remains poor

references.locator: Extended Data Fig. 5d verifies ROC; PR is an additional companion

entries.name: Confusion matrix
entries.question: Which habitats or classes are confused?
entries.minimum_data: Held-out labels, predictions and class counts
entries.design_tip: Show raw support and clearly state normalization direction
entries.interpretation_limit: Row-normalized percentages can hide poorly represented classes

entries.name: Calibration or reliability plot
entries.question: Do predicted probabilities match observed frequencies?
entries.minimum_data: Held-out probabilities and outcomes
entries.design_tip: Add probability-bin support and uncertainty
entries.interpretation_limit: Calibration depends on prevalence and binning; discrimination and calibration differ

entries.name: Residual diagnostic panels
entries.question: Where does a model systematically fail?
entries.minimum_data: Held-out residuals, predictions, location and covariates
entries.design_tip: Align residual-versus-fit, covariate and spatial views as needed
entries.interpretation_limit: Spatially structured residuals invalidate claims of uniformly good performance

entries.name: Permutation-importance interval plot
entries.question: Which features support predictive performance?
entries.minimum_data: Repeated held-out importance estimates and a defined metric
entries.design_tip: Show uncertainty and group correlated predictors when justified
entries.interpretation_limit: Importance is model-dependent and not a causal effect; correlated predictors share signal

references.locator: Extended Data Fig. 4 verifies variable-importance encoding

entries.name: SHAP beeswarm or dependence plot
entries.question: How does a fitted model allocate prediction contributions?
entries.minimum_data: Valid explanation values, input features and background specification
entries.design_tip: Label units, reference output and a small set of important features
entries.interpretation_limit: SHAP attribution is not causality and depends on assumptions about dependent features

entries.name: Validation-stratum performance plot
entries.question: Does performance transfer across sites, seasons or biomes?
entries.minimum_data: Per-stratum held-out metrics, uncertainty and sample counts
entries.design_tip: Align interval estimates and expose low-support strata
entries.interpretation_limit: Keep tuning outside the test sets; overall performance can hide subgroup failure

entries.name: Variation-partitioning diagram
entries.question: How much community variation is associated with environmental and spatial predictor sets?
entries.minimum_data: Appropriate fitted models and adjusted fractions
entries.design_tip: Use labelled fractions or aligned bars for unique and shared portions
entries.interpretation_limit: Shared fractions are not causal allocations; some adjusted fractions can be negative

entries.name: Neutral-model occupancy–abundance plot
entries.question: Are taxon occurrence frequencies consistent with a fitted neutral expectation?
entries.minimum_data: Mean abundance, occupancy, detection assumptions and fitted intervals
entries.design_tip: Overlay observed taxa and the model envelope
entries.interpretation_limit: Departure from one neutral model does not uniquely identify a deterministic mechanism

entries.name: Phylogenetic/taxonomic turnover quadrant
entries.question: Which sample pairs meet assembly-model classification criteria?
entries.minimum_data: Pairwise null-model statistics such as betaNTI and RCbray
entries.design_tip: Label method-specific thresholds and report pair counts
entries.interpretation_limit: The categories depend on the null and phylogenetic assumptions; pairs are not independent

entries.name: Assembly-process contribution display
entries.question: How do inferred assembly classifications vary among treatments?
entries.minimum_data: Classified pairwise comparisons with denominators and uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Use aligned proportions and explicit unclassified categories
entries.interpretation_limit: Inferred process fractions are model classifications, not measured physical fluxes

entries.name: Structural equation or path-model diagram
entries.question: Which hypothesized direct and indirect relationships fit the observations?
entries.minimum_data: A justified model, estimates, uncertainty and fit diagnostics
entries.design_tip: Keep paths sparse and label standardized versus raw coefficients
entries.interpretation_limit: Arrows express model assumptions; observational fit alone does not identify causation

entries.name: Niche-response surface
entries.question: How does abundance respond to two environmental gradients jointly?
entries.minimum_data: Adequate two-dimensional coverage and a fitted response with uncertainty
entries.design_tip: Show contours plus sampled predictor combinations
entries.interpretation_limit: Unsupported corners of predictor space should remain visibly uncertain or masked

entries.name: Missingness and sampling-balance matrix
entries.question: Which measurements and design combinations are missing?
entries.minimum_data: Sample-by-variable availability and design metadata
entries.design_tip: Use a small categorical key and preserve design order
entries.interpretation_limit: Missing, below detection, ineligible and zero must be separate states

entries.name: Genome-quality trade-off scatter
entries.question: Which assemblies combine completeness with low contamination?
entries.minimum_data: Genome quality estimates, sizes and classification metadata
entries.design_tip: Show informative decision boundaries with readable observations
entries.interpretation_limit: Completeness and contamination estimates are method-dependent

references.locator: Fig. 1b quality metrics; proposed bivariate layout

entries.name: Multiverse or sensitivity plot
entries.question: Do conclusions persist under justified analytical choices?
entries.minimum_data: Estimates across documented preprocessing or model alternatives
entries.design_tip: Group choices visibly and retain unfavorable results
entries.interpretation_limit: Alternatives must be scientifically defensible; this is not a search for significance

entries.name: Null or permutation reference distribution
entries.question: How unusual is an observed statistic under a stated null?
entries.minimum_data: Null draws, observed value and the permutation scheme
entries.design_tip: Mark the observed statistic and define the tested tail
entries.interpretation_limit: Exchanges must respect site, temporal and repeated-measures structure

entries.name: Sequencing or measurement control scatter
entries.question: Do technical controls behave as expected?
entries.minimum_data: Spike-ins, mock communities, blanks or species-mixing results
entries.design_tip: Show control identities and a meaningful expectation line
entries.interpretation_limit: Good technical agreement does not establish ecological representativeness
